scope: Independent semantic review, handwritten boundary consumers, and repository-generated exact type enforcement for all six theorems. The enforcing driver checks defining module, explicit universe arity, elaborated type equality, approved axioms and imported project theorem environment. Development evidence only; not a clean committed promotion gate.
semantic_findings: The lift is exactly P(x-y) + L sum(y) - c; both coordinates are independent full real vectors.
Convexity is inherited under the affine difference map with no hidden positivity restriction on L or c.
Monotonicity requires both P and L sum minus P to be monotone, a genuine upper-and-lower increment condition rather than the desired lifted conclusion as a hypothesis.
Nonnegativity is claimed only for nonnegative expanded inputs, with the explicit normalization c <= P(0).

The affine-line derivative helper assumes actual HasDerivAt facts on all real lines and nonnegative derivatives only in nonnegative directions; the conclusion is the ordinary product-order monotonicity of f.
The finite-index lift admits the empty index case, while line helpers correctly require no Fintype instance.
boundary_consumers: A constant-zero profile at L=c=0 on Fin 2 satisfies the monotonicity hypotheses and conclusion.
For Fin 0, the lift reduces to P(0)-c for all L and all expanded inputs.

handwritten_driver.purpose: Initial full-forall elaboration and boundary consumers; supplemented by enforcing repository driver.
